title: Conditional negative-spin background with Hubble-cutoff holographic energy
assumptions: Phenomenological flat-FLRW Friedmann pair with negative 3Mp²Phi² density, Phi∝a^−3, separately conserved dust and rhoX=3d²Mp²H²; radiation neglected and no separate Lambda.
The claimed Frenkel/Weyssenhoff nonzero trace source is internally inconsistent; retained background equations are a conditional ansatz pending source reconciliation.
Quoted d fit fixes Omega_m0=.3 and uses one cited local Pantheon q0 summary; it is not a multi-probe/current-data fit.
predictions: Conditional expansion has E²=[Omega_m0(1+z)³−Delta(1+z)^6]/(1−d²), Delta=Omega_m0+d²−1, and wX=−Delta(1+z)³/[Omega_m0−Delta(1+z)³].
Negative stiff scaling can yield a negative q locally, but the quoted branch ceases to have E²>0 beyond z*=.249 and cannot represent a full cosmological history.
Torsion-free Hubble-cutoff noninteracting energy returns to dust; d→0 is not a continuous LambdaCDM recovery in the displayed physical branch.
